CLI","maintainers":[{"name":"vartec569","email":"vartec569@gmail.com"}],"readme":"# Radix CLI (`radix-ai-cli`)

Autonomous Multi-Agent Software Engineering Developer Tool.

## Installation

Install globally via npm:

```bash
npm install -g radix-ai-cli
```

Or run directly without installation:

```bash
npx radix-ai-cli
```

## Usage

Navigate to any project directory:

```bash
cd /path/to/your/project
radix
```

## Features

- Zero-Copy External Workspace Isolation
- 26 Specialized Engineering Agents
- Real-time Web Monitoring (`http://localhost:8000`)
- Built-in Slash Commands: `/mcp`, `/session`, `/new-session`
